title: Aurum Alpha primitive representations
description: Wire-form definitions for identifiers, timestamps, dates, durations, and money. Governed by standards/020-identifiers.md; other contracts reference these $defs instead of restating patterns. schemaVersion 1 — evolves additively per PC6.

uuidv7.description: RFC 9562 UUIDv7, lowercase canonical hyphenated wire form. The default row public id (IP2 part A).

uuidv4.description: RFC 9562 UUIDv4, lowercase canonical hyphenated wire form. A row public id where the creation time is sensitive (IP2 part A).

nanoid.description: Row public id for an id a person types (IP2 part A): nanoid default alphabet, length >= 12. The alphabet contains '_', so a display handle is also a valid nanoid by shape; the generator retries on that shape and the CHECK on a new table's public_id column refuses it.

prefixedHandle.description: Display handle (IP2 part B): a value shown to a person for support, integration or connectivity. Lowercase prefix, one underscore, base62 body >= 12 so the first underscore always delimits the prefix. An attribute of a row in its own column; never a row public id, key, URL segment, grant scope or audit target id.

publicId.description: Any admitted row public id format (IP2 part A). Opaque to consumers (IP3). The display handle is not a member: a field that holds one references prefixedHandle directly.

timestamp.description: Canonical instant for persistence and emission: RFC 3339, UTC, Z suffix, at the repository's one pinned fractional precision — 3 digits by default, 6 or 9 where a repository pins finer timekeeping, never fewer and never mixed widths within an emitter (IP4). Request-side schemas use timestampInput instead.

timestampInput.description: Accept-side instant: any valid RFC 3339 date-time, offset forms and lowercase t/z included. The server normalises to the canonical timestamp def before persistence (IP4). Never used for stored or emitted shapes.

date.description: Calendar date, RFC 3339 full-date: no time, no zone (IP4).

duration.description: A span of time: an ISO 8601 duration, PnYnMnWnDTnHnMnS, with a fraction allowed on the lowest-order component only. Accepted in any valid form, emitted canonically: zero components dropped, PT0S for none, no unit folded into another. Years and months are calendar units and never convert to days (IP6). A measurement the server observed is a number, not this.

money.description: Integer count of minor units plus explicit currency; the minor-unit exponent is the currency's own per ISO 4217 (IP5). Floats are not admitted.

amount.description: Signed count of the currency's minor units. Implementations hold this in a 64-bit integer; values outside int64 are out of contract.
